Topics · One God, one message

Is my group the saved group?

Many groups say so. The Quran asks proof, sets names aside for one description, and leaves God the verdict.

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَقَالُوا۟ لَن يَدْخُلَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ إِلَّا مَن كَانَ هُودًا أَوْ نَصَـٰرَىٰ ۗ تِلْكَ أَمَانِيُّهُمْ ۗ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَـٰنَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And they say, "None will enter Paradise except one who is a Jew or a Christian." That is [merely] their wishful thinking. Say, "Produce your proof, if you should be truthful."

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:111

Translation

Don’t trust in lying words, saying, ‘Yahweh’s temple, Yahweh’s temple, Yahweh’s temple, are these.’

Original · Hebrew

אַל־תִּבְטְח֣וּ לָכֶ֔ם אֶל־דִּבְרֵ֥י הַשֶּׁ֖קֶר לֵאמֹ֑ר הֵיכַ֤ל יְהוָה֙ הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה הֵיכַ֥ל יְהוָ֖ה הֵֽמָּה׃

Jeremiah · 7:4

World English Bible

Notice what happens when this claim is made: many sides make it, with equal certainty. If you say "we are the saved" and another says the same, certainty cannot decide between you. This verse quotes the sentence and gives it one word: wishes. It does not reply "you are mistaken". It says: bring your proof. That demand is entirely fair, because it applies to anyone who says the sentence, and those who follow this book come first.

A question for you

What is your evidence that your group is the nearest?

If you sayOur texts and scholars
ThenOthers have texts and scholars too. How do you test between all of them? The next question takes that seriously.
If you sayWhat I have seen it do in me
ThenThat is real, and many in other groups say it too. It tells you more about your heart than about the group.
If you sayI don't think I have one
ThenA fine admission. The next part may ease it: the answer does not begin with a group.

Part 2 of 3

﴿بَلَىٰ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ وَجْهَهُۥ لِلَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ فَلَهُۥٓ أَجْرُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Yes, [on the contrary], whoever submits his face [i.e., self] in Islām to Allāh while being a doer of good will have his reward with his Lord. And no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve.

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:112

Translation

After these things Yahweh’s word came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.”

Original · Hebrew

אַחַ֣ר ׀ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה הָיָ֤ה דְבַר־יְהוָה֙ אֶל־אַבְרָ֔ם בַּֽמַּחֲזֶ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר אַל־תִּירָ֣א אַבְרָ֗ם אָנֹכִי֙ מָגֵ֣ן לָ֔ךְ שְׂכָרְךָ֖ הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃

the Torah (Genesis) · 15:1

World English Bible

Having demanded proof, the Quran might be expected to say: the saved are us. Look instead: "Yes, whoever". That "whoever" means any person. All the names are dropped and two descriptions take their place: one who gives their whole face to God, and does good. No party is named. The measure is now something that can be true or untrue of any individual, and no one can inherit it or hand it out.

A question for you

Why does the verse leave names behind for a description?

If you sayTo keep the door open to anyone
ThenThere is mercy in that, and responsibility too: no one guaranteed, no one shut out.
If you sayBecause a name means nothing
ThenA name means something to those who love it, and they are free to. But it is not the measure here.
If you sayThis does not reassure me
ThenUnderstood. The comfort of belonging is real, and this can feel less safe. See what remains in the next part.

Part 3 of 3

﴿وَقَالَتِ ٱلْيَهُودُ لَيْسَتِ ٱلنَّصَـٰرَىٰ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ وَقَالَتِ ٱلنَّصَـٰرَىٰ لَيْسَتِ ٱلْيَهُودُ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ وَهُمْ يَتْلُونَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ۗ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ مِثْلَ قَوْلِهِمْ ۚ فَٱللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

The Jews say, "The Christians have nothing [true] to stand on," and the Christians say, "The Jews have nothing to stand on," although they [both] recite the Scripture. Thus do those who know not [i.e., the polytheists] speak the same as their words. But Allāh will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:113

﴿إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ وَٱلصَّـٰبِـِٔينَ وَٱلنَّصَـٰرَىٰ وَٱلْمَجُوسَ وَٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Indeed, those who have believed and those who were Jews and the Sabeans and the Christians and the Magians and those who associated with Allāh - Allāh will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allāh is, over all things, Witness.[919]

Translator's notes

[919] See footnote of 4:79.

Quran · Al-Hajj 22:17

Translation

Then you shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him who serves God and him who doesn’t serve him.

Original · Hebrew

וְשַׁבְתֶּם֙ וּרְאִיתֶ֔ם בֵּ֥ין צַדִּ֖יק לְרָשָׁ֑ע בֵּ֚ין עֹבֵ֣ד אֱלֹהִ֔ים לַאֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א עֲבָדֽוֹ׃

Malachi · 3:18

World English Bible

The first verse describes what usually happens: each side says the other stands on nothing, and both read their scripture. The second lists the communities, begins with those who believe, and says God will decide between them. The Quran hands the verdict to no one, not even its own followers. That does not make all claims equal: deciding means there is something to decide. But what is ours is to test claims. People themselves are not in our hands.

A question for you

What changes in how you speak of others if you leave the verdict on them to God?

The same in the other books

Translation

For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly. Yahweh of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.

כִּ֤י שֶׁ֨מֶשׁ ׀ וּמָגֵן֮ יְהוָ֪ה אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים חֵ֣ן וְ֭כָבוֹד יִתֵּ֣ן יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֥א יִמְנַע־ט֝֗וֹב לַֽהֹלְכִ֥ים בְּתָמִֽים׃ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֑וֹת אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י אָ֝דָ֗ם בֹּטֵ֥חַ בָּֽךְ׃

the Psalms · 84:11-12

Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

χωρὶς δὲ πίστεως ἀδύνατον εὐαρεστῆσαι, πιστεῦσαι γὰρ δεῖ τὸν προσερχόμενον τῷ θεῷ ὅτι ἔστιν καὶ τοῖς ἐκζητοῦσιν αὐτὸν μισθαποδότης γίνεται.

Hebrews · 11:6

World English Bible

so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”

Original · Hebrew

וְיֹאמַ֣ר אָ֭דָם אַךְ־פְּרִ֣י לַצַּדִּ֑יק אַ֥ךְ יֵשׁ־אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים שֹׁפְטִ֥ים בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

the Psalms · 58:11

Translation

“Come now, and let’s reason together,” says Yahweh: “Though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they are red like crimson, they shall be as wool. If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good of the land; but if you refuse and rebel, you will be devoured with the sword; for Yahweh’s mouth has spoken it.”

Isaiah · 1:18-20

World English Bible
